attributes.action: Mandate Cooling Measures in UK (including homes, schools, offices & transport).
attributes.additional_details: We want the Government to require effective cooling measures in schools, workplaces, public transport, outdoor bus stops and public buildings. Heatwaves are becoming more frequent, causing thousands of heat-related deaths and increasing the risk of heatstroke, dehydration and illness. National standards are needed to protect public health.
attributes.background: Require the Government to mandate effective cooling measures in schools, workplaces, public transport, outdoor bus stops and other public buildings to protect people during increasingly frequent and severe heatwaves.

rejection.details:
We are unclear what you are calling for in regards to effective cooling measures, and how for example, that would work at a bus stop.

There are some open petitions calling for similar actions which you may wish to sign:

Introduce national heatwave resilience strategy & legal protections
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770813

Mandate working a/c and heating systems on all new public transport vehicles
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771285

Require employers to have adequate cooling devices i.e. fans or aircon
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774166
